## Risk and rollback

Describe known risks, impacted platforms, data/backup compatibility, and the recovery approach.

## Checklist

- [ ] PR targets `dev` (or `main` only for a documented release/hotfix)
- [ ] Diff is focused and self-reviewed
- [ ] Issue and acceptance criteria are referenced, unless trivial
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior
- [ ] CI checks pass on latest commit before merge
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated if relevant (English)
- [ ] PT-PT and EN user-facing messages updated together if relevant
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or production backup contents
- [ ] Additional RHEL/Debian and recovery validation documented for high-risk changes

> PRs into `dev` normally use **Squash Merge**. Release PRs from `dev` to `main` use **Merge Commit**. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [docs/RELEASING.md](../docs/RELEASING.md).
